annotation.note: Pixel landmarks read by eye on a 682x1024 downscale of source.jpg (same photo, 2:3). Estimated error about +/-5 px (about 0.6% of figure height). Only points visible in the photo are annotated; back and hidden joins are production inference, not evidence.
annotation.pose_caveat: The wearer is turning, so the skirt hem is raised on the viewer's right; hem values use the lowest, front-centre edge.

doll_mapping.note: The shared VolumeDoll has a larger head than the wearer, so heights are mapped piecewise-linearly from two body anchors: chin -> doll y 2.01 and shoe top -> doll y 0.158. y = 2.01 - 2.324 * (fraction - 0.158). Units are doll metres.
